metadata.title: 42 U.S.C. 300aa-26 (PHS Act section 2126) - Vaccine information
metadata.legal_basis: United States Code (2024 edition); binding statute. The official text governs; check for later amendments.
metadata.applicability: Vaccine Information Statements on benefits and risks, required before vaccine administration.

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.

candidates.statement: Not later than 1 year after December 22, 1987, the Secretary shall develop and disseminate vaccine information materials for distribution by health care providers to the legal representatives of any child or to any other individual receiving a vaccine set forth in the Vaccine Injury Table. Such materials shall be published in the Federal Register and may be revised.

candidates.anchor: (b) Development and revision of materials / paragraph-5
candidates.statement: Such materials shall be developed or revised—
candidates.context: (b) Development and revision of materials (1) after notice to the public and 60 days of comment thereon, and

candidates.statement: The information in such materials shall be based on available data and information, shall be presented in understandable terms and shall include—
candidates.context: (c) Information requirements (1) a concise description of the benefits of the vaccine,

candidates.statement: each health care provider who administers a vaccine set forth in the Vaccine Injury Table shall provide to the legal representatives of any child or to any other individual to whom such provider intends to administer such vaccine a copy of the information materials developed pursuant to subsection (a), supplemented with visual presentations or oral explanations, in appropriate cases. Such materials shall be provided prior to the administration of such vaccine.
